race.title: QuinnBet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SPARTAN TIMES returns from a short break with his yard continuing in excellent order and given there's still scope from his current mark based on his Flat form, he could be the answer. Lunar Orbit and French recruit Zeus Forlonge head the opposition. SPARTAN TIMES LUNAR ORBIT (IRE) ZEUS FORLONGE (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Spartan Times (11/4), Lunar Orbit (4/1), Mooserwirt (9/2), Zeus Forlonge (5/1), Back In The Bay (8/1), Rumi Rock (10/1), Tao Enki (12/1), Getaway With You (14/1)
